bounded_residency_design.root_loader: Root-on-demand streaming loader reads one root record at a time from DerivedCache byte offsets, validates schema and pair integrity, constructs LearnerRecords, and allocates tensors only for that single root.
bounded_residency_design.test_residency: One root tensor set at a time evaluated under model.eval() and torch.no_grad(). Exactly one test evaluation executed after best checkpoint restoration; only scalar root losses retained.
bounded_residency_design.training_residency: At most the 64-root computation graph for the active minibatch resides on MPS during forward accumulation. Gradients are backpropagated on (total_loss / B) and batch tensors/graph are deallocated upon optimizer step.
bounded_residency_design.validation_residency: One root tensor set at a time evaluated under model.eval() and torch.no_grad(). Only scalar root NLL is retained; tensors are deallocated before next root is loaded.

durable_result_seal_schema.persistence_contract: Write to .tmp_{filename}_{pid} -> flush -> os.fsync(file) -> atomic os.replace -> os.fsync(directory)

scenarios_tested: A: Fresh empty result directory -> all expected fake jobs execute and seal
B: Interrupt after N successful fake jobs -> N seals survive
C: Restart -> N valid seals reused and only missing jobs execute
D: Corrupt sealed payload -> startup fails closed
E: Modify payload without matching hash -> fails closed
F: Wrong implementation SHA -> fails closed
G: Wrong protocol SHA -> fails closed
H: Wrong label SHA -> fails closed
I: Wrong runtime identity/pin -> fails closed
J: Wrong population digest -> fails closed
L: Duplicate logical tuple -> fails closed
M: Leftover partial/temp artifact (.tmp_*) -> fails closed
N: Existing valid final file cannot be silently overwritten
P: Finalization with exact 160 valid results -> passes

worst_frozen_minibatch_pair_census.search_space: All 5 seeds (1729, 2718, 31415, 65537, 104729) x 200 epochs x 20,000-root nominal budget (1,000 epoch permutations)
